content.short: Hyperithm is a global digital asset manager running market-neutral strategies and curating vaults.
content.description: Hyperithm is a digital asset manager delivering market-neutral returns through systematic arbitrage across crypto and traditional markets. Its strategies include on-chain equity arbitrage, work that has drawn coverage in Bloomberg. It runs vaults on Hyperliquid, with performance measured over trailing twelve months.
content.meta: Market-neutral strategies from an institutional manager, offered as curated vaults.
